questions.question: What did Absalom do to win the hearts of Israel?
options: Led the army to a great victory over the Philistines
Stood at the gate, flattering people seeking justice
Built a great and costly temple to honor the LORD
Gave lavish gifts to all of the leading tribal heads
questions.answer: Stood at the gate, flattering people seeking justice
